privacy_header_title: Aapki privacy hamare liye intehai ahem hai
privacy_last_updated: Aakhri baar update kiya gaya: January 2026
privacy_sec1_title: 1. Hum kaun sa data jama karte hain?
privacy_sec1_content: Hum aapka naam, username, profile photo, game character ID (UID) aur email address jama karte hain jab aap account banate hain.
privacy_sec2_title: 2. Data ka istemal kaise kiya jata hai?
privacy_sec2_content: Aapka data aapki profile ko behtar banane, tournaments aur matches ke intezamat, aur community ke usoolon par amal daramad ke liye istemal hota hai.
privacy_sec3_content: Hum aapke zaati data ki hifazat ke liye jadeed encryption aur security ke behtareen tareeqay istemal karte hain.
privacy_sec4_content: Hum aapke tajurbay ko behtar banane aur tarjeehat ko mehfooz rakhne ke liye local storage aur cookies ka istemal karte hain.
privacy_sec5_content: Hum Google sign-in aur ishteharaati networks jaisi mehfooz third-party khidmaat istemal karte hain jo unki apni privacy policies ke tehat kaam karti hain.
privacy_sec6_content: Aapko kisi bhi waqt apna profile data dekhne, us mein tarmeem karne ya 'Mera Data Download Karein' ke option se copy hasil karne ka mukammal haq hasil hai.
privacy_sec7_content: Hum 13 saal se kam umar bachon ka data jaan boojh kar jama nahi karte. Yeh app 13+ saal ke users ke liye banayi gayi hai.
privacy_sec8_content: Hum waqtan fawaqtan is privacy policy mein tabdeeliyan kar sakte hain. Ahem tabdeeliyon ka notification app mein de diya jayega.
terms_header_desc: Gamers ID app istemal karne se pehle in sharaait o zawabit ko ghaur se parh lein.
terms_last_updated: Aakhri baar update kiya gaya: January 2026
terms_sec1_item1: • Is app ko download ya istemal kar ke aap in sharaait se ittefaq karte hain.
terms_sec1_item2: • Agar aap in sharaait se muttafiq nahi hain, toh barahe karam app istemal na karein.
terms_sec1_item3: • Tamam users ke liye app ki policies ki pabandi karna lazmi hai.
terms_sec2_item1: • Aapka account aur uski security aapki apni zimmedari hai.
terms_sec2_item2: • Ek shakhs sirf ek hi asal gamer ID bana sakta hai.
terms_sec2_item3: • Galat ya fake maloomat dene par account suspend kiya ja sakta hai.
terms_sec2_item4: • Profile naam aur bio mein na-munasib zuban istemal karna mana hai.
terms_sec3_item1: • Doosre gamers ke sath izzat aur ehtaram se pesh aayein.
terms_sec3_item2: • Harasani, gaali galoch ya nafrat angez zuban par sakht pabandi hai.
terms_sec3_item3: • Chats ya posts mein ghair mutaliqa ya spam links share na karein.
terms_sec3_item4: • Fake screenshots ya galat proof jama karana mamnoo hai.
terms_sec3_item5: • Community guidelines todne par account permanent ban ho sakta hai.
terms_sec3_item6: • Admin ka faisla hatmi aur sab ke liye qabil-e-qubool hoga.
terms_sec4_item1: • Custom rooms aur tournaments mein di gayi hidayaat par sakhti se amal karein.
terms_sec4_item2: • Match ke dauran hacking ya cheating ka istemal karne par na-ahal kar diya jayega.
terms_sec4_item3: • Inaamat aur coins sirf usool pooray karne wale winners ko milenge.
terms_sec4_item4: • Match ke nataaij par tanaza hone ki soorat mein admin proof ki jaanch karega.
terms_sec5_item1: • G-Coins sirf app ke androoni features aur inaamat ke liye hain.
terms_sec5_item2: • Coins ko ghair qanooni tareeqon se hasil karne ki koshish na karein.
terms_sec5_item3: • Daily bonus aur referral systems ke tey shuda usool laagu honge.
terms_sec5_item4: • Company kisi bhi waqt coins policy mein tabdeeli ka haq mehfooz rakhti hai.
terms_sec6_item1: • Aap app par jo bhi clips ya posts share karenge, aap khud uske zimmedar hain.
terms_sec6_item2: • Copyright ya chori shuda mawaad upload karne ki ijazat nahi.
terms_sec6_item3: • Na-munasib ya adult content share karne par sakht karrawai hogi.
terms_sec6_item4: • Admin ko yeh ikhtiyar hasil hai ke woh kisi bhi post ko delete kar sake.
terms_sec7_item1: • Aapka zaati data hamari privacy policy ke tehat mehfooz rehta hai.
terms_sec7_item2: • Hum aapka koi bhi data kisi third-party ko nahi bechte.
terms_sec7_item3: • Aap kisi bhi waqt apna account ya data delete karne ki request de sakte hain.
terms_sec7_item4: • App ki behtari ke liye analytics ka istemal kiya jata hai.
terms_sec8_item1: • App mein dikhaye jaane wale ads sponsors ki taraf se hote hain.
terms_sec8_item2: • Berooni websites ya links ki security ki zimmedari hamari nahi hai.
terms_sec8_item3: • Rewarded ads dekhne par tey shuda coins aapke wallet mein shamil kiye jayenge.
terms_sec8_item4: • Ads ke sath chherr chhaar ya bypass karne ki koshish na karein.
terms_sec9_item1: • Sharaait ki khilaf warzi par aapka account aarzi ya mustaqil band ho sakta hai.
terms_sec9_item2: • Muatal shuda account ke coins ya data ki wapsi ki koi guarantee nahi.
terms_sec9_item3: • Muatli ke khilaf appeal ke liye aap support team se raabta kar sakte hain.
terms_sec10_item1: • App ko baghair kisi guarantee (As Is) ke faraham kiya ja raha hai.
terms_sec10_item2: • Internet connection ya server ki kharabi ki wajah se hone wale nuqsan ke hum zimmedar nahi.
terms_sec10_item3: • Gamers ID network kisi bhi technical kharabi ke liye zimmedar nahi hoga.
terms_sec11_item1: • Hum kisi bhi waqt in service ki sharaait mein tabdeeli kar sakte hain.
terms_sec11_item2: • Bari tabdeeliyon ka itlaaq app par notice ke baad ho jayega.
terms_sec11_item3: • App ka musalsal istemal in nayi sharaait ki qubooliat samjha jayega.
